title: A lead change adds one history entry and none for the lines it moves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Three eligible technicians at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"), [Tech-B] (e.g. "Ralph Edwards"), [Tech-C] (e.g. "Dana Ortiz"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History" (used by this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by [Tech-A], with two lines that both follow the lead (no technician of their own).
  • Names and the number are examples; what must hold: two lines follow the lead.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Use one location for the whole case: it is shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard), [Tech-B] (e.g. Ralph Edwards), [Tech-C] (e.g. Dana Ortiz).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A]; add a second line (e.g. "Oil change") with no technician before setting the lead, so both lines follow [Tech-A].
  6. Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History" shows [WO-1] with Lead Technician [Tech-A]; on its Lines tab both lines show [Tech-A] in their Labor row. If not, fix it on the work order page before starting; then clear the search.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Lead History" in Search.
  3. Note the time, then drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column.
  4. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  5. Open the work order and open its change history (audit log). Write down where you found it.
  6. Count the entries added by this change.
  7. On the Lines tab click the first line's name to open the Edit Line dialog and set Technicians to [Tech-C], then save.
  8. Open the change history again and read the newest entries.
  9. Repeat steps 3 to 6 using More actions > Reassign lead technician ([Tech-B] → [Tech-A]), then once more by changing Lead Technician on the work order page ([Tech-A] → [Tech-B]).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each lead change (drag, Reassign dialog, work order page) adds exactly one entry showing the previous lead, the new lead, your user as the person who made it, and the time (e.g. Esther Howard → Ralph Edwards, by you, at the time you noted).
  • No separate entries appear for the two lines that moved with the lead (3 lead changes = 3 entries, not 9).
  • Changing a line's technician directly in Edit Line still adds its own line entry, as it does today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R9, S4-R17, S4-R18, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions FF-4 history (audit actor is the logged-in user). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R9: “Every lead-change path records one audit entry with the previous lead, new lead, logged-in actor, and time.”
  • S4-R17: “Do not create separate audit entries for implicit line movements caused by a lead change.”
  • S4-R18: “Continue existing line auditing for technician changes made directly on a work order line.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
